raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
BNY Mellon | Pune, India	May 2022 – Jan 2026
Associate II (Senior Business Analyst — Capital Markets & Middle Office)
Led end-to-end BA delivery across Fixed Income, Loan Syndication, and OTC Derivatives — scoping trade booking, validation, reconciliation, settlement, and post-trade processing; produced BPMN process models and DFDs, accelerating UAT cycles and reducing implementation ambiguity.
Primary BA for trade break investigations — structured root cause analysis and multi-stakeholder coordination across Front Office, Operations, Technology, and Custodians; system fixes measurably reduced break volumes and improved downstream data quality.
Led GRX automation initiative (BRD/FRD, workflow design, UAT, production deployment) — eliminated 1 FTE of manual effort and improved STP rates by ~25%.
Owned full Loan Syndication transition (US→Pune) — gap analysis, TOM documentation, SOPs, stakeholder workshops, training; zero operational disruption on go-live.
Delivered SWIFT/CHAPS/SEPA payment processing enhancements — MT103/202/900/910 handling, nostro/vostro redesign, settlement failure resolution workflows; reduced cash break resolution time by 35%.
Applied SQL queries to analyse trade records, identify settlement failure patterns, and validate data across systems — findings translated into requirements and resolution workflows; contributed to ~20% reduction in recurring settlement fail rates.
Recognised with 5 VIP Awards (2024–2025) for resolving long-standing client break issues; directly contributing to a 7-year client contract extension.
Mentored junior analysts and led cross-functional stakeholder workshops to drive requirements alignment and influence delivery prioritisation across concurrent project workstreams.
Morgan Stanley | Mumbai, India	Dec 2018 – May 2022
Associate (Business Analyst — Trade Lifecycle & Middle Office)
Delivered trade lifecycle system enhancements across Equity, FX, Rates, and Commodities — requirements elicitation, functional analysis, JIRA backlog management, and stakeholder sign-off through full SDLC.
Root cause analysis on persistent trade and data exceptions; collaborated with Technology, Operations, and vendors (Eclerx, DS Match) to implement long-term remediation and document fix requirements.
Applied SQL to query trade and position data, validate system outputs, and produce analysis reports supporting requirements definition and defect resolution during UAT.
Produced process flows, DFDs, and workflow models for system improvements; delivered operational dashboards tracking key risk indicators for senior leadership.
Morgan Stanley | Mumbai, India	Jun 2017 – Dec 2018
Middle Office Analyst — Equity Swaps SME
Equity Swaps SME — full trade lifecycle management: booking, validation, reconciliation, rate resets, dividend adjustments, and corporate action processing across global portfolios.
Led process transition from London/Bangalore to Mumbai — SOPs, training delivery, zero go-live disruption. First-line escalation for complex trade breaks and settlement failures.
SELECTED PROJECTS — END-TO-END BA DELIVERY
Payments Lifecycle Enhancement (SWIFT/CHAPS/SEPA) Three workstreams: MT103/202/900/910 handling, nostro/vostro redesign, settlement failure resolution. BRD/FRD, BPMN, two UAT cycles. Outcome: 35% reduction in cash break resolution time. Cash Reconciliation Automation (GRX) Self-identified opportunity; feasibility assessment; formalised matching rules from analyst knowledge. BRD/FRD, GRX workflow design, parallel-run go-live. Outcome: 1 FTE eliminated; improved data accuracy. Bond Lifecycle Enhancement (Fixed Income) Audit-initiated. Four workstreams: coupon accrual, interest payments, principal redemption, amortisation. BRD/FRD, BPMN, data migration spec. Outcome: 40% reduction in manual touch-points; audit finding closed. Equity Swap Lifecycle Enhancement SME background leveraged. Five workstreams: booking validation, rate resets, dividend adjustment, corporate actions, reconciliation. JIRA backlog, phased go-live. Outcome: Break volumes reduced; rate reset processing STP. Trade Booking Validation Automation (GRX) Self-identified; 85% of checks automatable. BRD/FRD, GRX workflow, single UAT cycle. Outcome: 30 mins/analyst/day saved; improved STP rates. Bank Loan Process Transition (USA→Pune) Gap analysis, SOPs, BPMN maps, knowledge transfer workshops, four-week parallel run, readiness assessment. Outcome: Zero disruption on go-live; no client complaints.
Corporate Actions Application Enhancement Enhancements for spin-offs and mergers. Error log analysis to scope; functional specs, decision trees, BPMN. Outcome: Error rates reduced for high-complexity event types.
